The blocking RAW dependence is on array elements of `u`: line 7 reads `u[ku[i]]` which was written by line 6 in an earlier iteration. This is a loop-carried dependence where values flow through the array across iterations.

The fix is to **split the single loop into two sequential phases**:
1. Phase 1: Execute all u-update operations (line 6) for all i
2. Phase 2: Execute all v-update operations (line 7) for all i

After phase 1 completes, all u values have been updated, so phase 2 can read them without loop-carried dependence. Each phase becomes a Do-All pattern that DiscoPoP can recognize and parallelize.

This preserves correctness because line 7 in the original code only reads u values written in earlier iterations—by splitting into two sequential loops, we ensure all those writes complete before any reads in phase 2.
